reference_class.ratio_policy: Compiler-only source slices; language/parser/theorem-scope limits in calibration.json; no whole-repository cross-system reachability fraction.

limitations: Lexical matches overconnect local/overloaded names and do not resolve namespaces or elaborated generated declarations.
Implicit closure is sensitivity analysis, not a proven upper bound; notation, tactics, syntax quotation, mutual blocks and macros can hide dependencies.
Source generation markers are heuristic; filename-only chain/agreement candidates are separate; unmarked generated files may be missed.
No reachability fraction proves code removable; external clients and goals outside the pinned roots are outside the model.
Non-Lean test execution is not modeled; tracked Lean consumers and literal CI Lake targets (with executable aliases) define the available roots; dynamic CI target construction may be missed.
Missing external imports (Lean/Mathlib/dependency packages absent from tracked source) are outside the graph; vendored files are tracked separately.
Near-duplicate statements need not prove the same theorem; near files alpha-normalize numerals, so equivalence is not asserted.
